metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-eb[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Highlight-friendly table layout for bob ref create PDFs[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Tables whose cells hold prose print in bob-typeset reference PDFs [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim](Markdown, vault-note, and web-article routes) as single-column row[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]records that Highlights can select and annotate on macOS 26. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Short-cell data tables keep a more readable grid. The choice can be[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]reversed at the config, document, and table level, existing PDFs [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]are never touched, and the result is checked for text fidelity, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]page counts, and PDFKit selection on the Mac.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Table-layout Lua pass with prose-table records[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]records-filter[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]records-filter: build the embedded table_layout.lua pass [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](classification, override precedence, complex-table guard, row-record [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]layout, JSON report) plus its TeX macros and Rust embedding module, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tested by running pandoc on the filter directly.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Wire the table pass into both pandoc chains, config, and docs[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]pandoc-wiring[dim] · [dim][/dim]after records-filter[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]pandoc-wiring: add highlights.table_layout and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]highlights.table_prose_words, run the pass first in the Markdown and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]note-snapshot chains, print the tables summary line and warnings, cover [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the return-link and code-catalog contracts end to end, and document the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]feature in help and docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Improved grid for data and complex tables[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]data-grid[dim] · [dim][/dim]after pandoc-wiring[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]data-grid: give every table that stays a grid content-aware column [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]widths and row air at body size, plus optional hairline row rules behind[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the grid_hairlines decision.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Records and grid cleanup on the web-clip print route[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]web-clip[dim] · [dim][/dim]after pandoc-wiring[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]web-clip: carry the table settings in the adapter request, rewrite prose[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tables into record markup on the print DOM only, clean up reader.css [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]grids, report counts back to bob, and add a tables fixture to the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]adapter self-test.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Draft the PDFKit table-selection reports[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]pdfkit-report[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]pdfkit-report: write ready-to-send drafts for the Highlights developer [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and Apple Feedback that describe the macOS 26 table-cell selection [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]takeover, for Bryan to send himself.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Fidelity, page-count, and Mac probe acceptance[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]acceptance[dim] · [dim][/dim]after data-grid, web-clip[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]acceptance: compare baseline and new renders of fixtures and real chat [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reports for text fidelity and page counts, rerun the PDFKit cell probe [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]on the Mac (with a bulleted-record fallback), write the acceptance [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]report and Bryan's manual checklist, and optionally record the decision.[/#D7D7AF]
